purpose: Preserve the next executable frontier so a fresh parent does not have to reinvent the post-convergence campaign. These are candidate seeds until B-BIGPIC-01 convergence resolves dependencies/owners and promotes them into the real Opportunity Queue.
selection_law: Promote only after Architecture/Active Method vNext reconciliation; merge/split/retire seeds explicitly instead of newest-wins.
